name: Republic of China (1912–1928)

flag.description: Five equal horizontal stripes of red, yellow, blue, white and black.
flag.symbolism: The five colours are usually said to stand for the five major peoples of the republic: the Han (red), Manchus (yellow), Mongols (blue), Hui (white) and Tibetans (black).

hook: The early Republic of China flew five plain stripes, red, yellow, blue, white and black, one for each of its "five races"; Manchukuo squeezed four of them into the corner of a yellow flag.
trivia: It was replaced nationally in 1928 by the Kuomintang's flag with the white sun on a blue canton, after the Northern Expedition reunified the country.
The five-coloured flag was revived in the late 1930s by the Japanese-backed Reformed Government of the Republic of China.
